as_told.title: Rick Strassman's DMT studies in room 531 of the University of New Mexico hospital
as_told.place_text: University of New Mexico hospital, Albuquerque, New Mexico

plain: In the early 1990s a researcher named Rick Strassman gave DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, to 60 volunteers, and many described experiences like alien abductions. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore describes the study without citing a source, calling it "a much larger study" than earlier work, and in another part of the talk he places it in "room 531" of the University of New Mexico hospital, with no count or details of what was reported. Gallimore tells it to suggest that DMT opens a door to a realm where such beings are met.
